name: agent402-function-calling
description: Agent402 tools as function-calling tool definitions, for use with the OpenAI API (chat.completions, Responses) and other function-calling APIs (Agentic Finance over x402 or MPP): turn tools from Agent402's catalog of 500+ pay-per-call tools and skill packs into tool definitions, one per catalog tool, with payment handled by agent402-client. Free via proof-of-work for the pure-CPU tools, or pay per call in USDC on 13 chains or USDG on Robinhood Chain. Formerly agent402-openai-tools.
